description: This file defines a client module for interacting with the Google Generative Language API (Gemini), including functions to prepare requests, handle histories, send asynchronous requests, and parse responses. It provides an interface for generating chatbot replies using Gemini models.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] _to_gemini_parts(text: str)
methods.description: Converts a text string into a list containing a single dictionary with the text, formatted for Gemini API.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _history_to_contents(history: List[HistoryItem])
methods.description: Transforms a list of HistoryItem objects into the Gemini 'contents' structure, mapping roles accordingly.

methods.name: str generate_reply(message: str, history: List[HistoryItem], api_key: str, model: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a reply from the Gemini API based on the provided user message and history, handling request formation and response parsing.

ctags.name: generate_reply
ctags.pattern: /^async def generate_reply(message: str, history: List[HistoryItem], api_key: str, model: str) -> /
ctags.signature: (message: str, history: List[HistoryItem], api_key: str, model: str)
